knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Access, water and power must be confirmed for each stop before work starts.
Wash water must be captured or taken to an approved point, not sent to a stormwater drain.
Running more tools than the generator rating allows is the error to avoid.

practicalCriteria: Learner plans a four-stop round from a supplied booking list with a round sheet of order, buffers, access, water and power per stop.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Completed artefact saved with date and version
Assessor record of knowledge check result
stopWorkCriteria: Learner treats a tax, licence or wastewater point as settled without checking it
